audit: civic difficulty mechanics static comparison of authored expanded dossiers

scope.checkout: own architect work unit, snapshot identified by source hashes
scope.instructionsRead: AGENTS.md in the inspected checkout; read-only collection
scope.sourceStructure: Each campaign JSON has top-level episodes[] containing authored dossier objects, separate from episodeSelection[] and episodeBlueprints[]. Audited episodes[] only.
scope.coverage: All current faith-origins and imperial-church episodes[] dossiers at the recorded source hashes; other campaigns and selections without dossiers excluded.

fieldMethod.enemyCount: enemyTotalCap per easy/standard/hard; cross-checked worldContract.entities roles containing hostile/enemy. scheduledWaveCount sums authored difficulty waves if present.
fieldMethod.deadline: Positive structured fields with deadline/timeLimit/countdown/expires/clock keys, excluding neverUseTimerInstead, roughDurationMinutes and release warning/offset fields. NeverUseTimerInstead is a prohibition, not an authored deadline.
fieldMethod.riskRule: Flag if there are no structured finite hostiles, no explicit deadline field, and accessibleWithoutOptionalRewards is identical for all three difficulties.
fieldMethod.objectives: Counts objectivePlan[] as main and secondaryObjectives[] as optional; predicate kinds are context only.

limits: Static schema/content inspection only; not proof of boredom, difficulty, playability, balance or engagement.

Task routing, resource gathering, ordered departure, distinct receipts, transport journeys, loss rules and optional opportunity costs can create decisions without combat or a deadline; they are listed as predicate kinds but not scored as equivalent to active opposition.
roughDurationMinutes is a planning estimate, not a hard deadline. Authored enemy specifications are not evidence of AoE2 implementation or playtesting.
No redesign, solutions or architectural approval.
